final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT b.link_to_event AS ev, e.location AS loc, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_v FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.location), s2 AS (SELECT ev, loc, avg_v, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY loc ORDER BY avg_v DESC) AS rk FROM s1) SELECT ev, loc, avg_v, rk FROM s2 WHERE rk <= 3
